Here we read the results from AlphaFold and try tp interpret all the models and quality score metrics:

```{r}
library(bio3d)

pth <- "dimer_23119/"
pdb.files <- list.files(path=pth, full.names = TRUE, pattern=".pdb")
```

Align and supperpose all these models
```{r}
file.exists(pdb.files)
```

```{r}
pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb.files, fit = TRUE, exefile="msa")
```

```{r}
library(bio3dview)
#view.pdbs(pdbs)
```

```{r}
plot(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l", ylim=c(0,100), ylab="pLDDT score")
lines(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="blue")
lines(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="green")
lines(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="orange")
lines(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="red")
```

## Predicted Alignment Error for domains

```{r}
library(jsonlite)

# Listing of all PAE JSON files
pae_files <- list.files(path=pth,
                        pattern=".*model.*\\.json",
                        full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
pae1 <- read_json(pae_files[1],simplifyVector = TRUE)
pae5 <- read_json(pae_files[5],simplifyVector = TRUE)

attributes(pae1)
```

```{r}
# Per-residue pLDDT scores 
#  same as B-factor of PDB..
head(pae1$plddt) 
```

```{r}
plot.dmat(pae1$pae, 
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col = "black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```


```{r}
plot.dmat(pae5$pae, 
          xlab="Residue Position (i)",
          ylab="Residue Position (j)",
          grid.col = "black",
          zlim=c(0,30))
```

```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs, fit=T)
range(rd)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
pheatmap(rd)
```

## Score Residue conservation from alignment file

```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(path=pth,
                       pattern=".a3m$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
aln_file
```

```{r}
aln <- read.fasta(aln_file[1], to.upper = TRUE)
```

```{r}
dim(aln$ali)
```

```{r}
sim <- conserv(aln)
```

```{r}
plotb3(sim[1:99],
       ylab="Conservation Score")
```

Find the consensus sequence at a very high cutoff

```{r}
con <- consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.9)
con$seq
```

```{r}
m1.pdb <- read.pdb(pdb.files[1])
occ <- vec2resno(c(sim[1:99], sim[1:99]), m1.pdb$atom$resno)
write.pdb(m1.pdb, o=occ, file="m1_conserv.pdb")
```
